92
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, December 16, 2014/Agrahayana 25, 1936 (Saka)
(Ministries : Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Defence; Finance; Health and
Family Welfare; Information and Broadcasting; Minority Affairs)
Total number of questions — 15
Dissemination of information relating
to the spread of HIV/AIDS
*291. SHRI A VINASH PANDE: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of schemes or
programmes being formulated/
implemented by Government for the
dissemination of information relating to the
spread of HIV/AIDS;
(b) whether any measures have been
taken to disseminate information among
the youth and adolescents in a targeted
manner; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Encroachment of defence land
*292. SHRI DEVENDER GOUD T.:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of defence (Army, Air
Force, Navy, Ordnance Factory, etc.) land
in the country, State-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that nearly 18
lakh acres of defence land is under
encroachment;
(c) if so, the details of each
encroachment, State-wise;
(d) the steps taken to clear the
encroachment; and
(e) how much land, in the last three
years, the Ministry has been able to clear
from the hands of encroachers, with a
particular reference to Andhra Pradesh and
Telangana?
Inclusion of autonomous institutions
under CGHS
*293. DR. T. N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND  FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
proposals from various autonomous
institutions including Kendriya Vidyalaya
Sangathan and Employees' Provident Fund
Organization regarding inclusion of their
employees under the Central Government
Health Scheme (CGHS);
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
response of Government thereto;
(c) whether a number of States and
Union Territories still do not have even a
single CGHS dispensary, if so, the details
thereof and the reasons therefor;

93
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) whether Government has failed to
expand CGHS facilities in the country due
to severe financial and other resource
constraints; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
reaction of Government thereto?
Complaints of dysfunctional ATMs
†*294. SHRI VISHAMBHAR
PRASAD NISHAD: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been a considerable rise in complaints of
dysfunctional ATMs of banks including
Public Sector Banks (PSBs) in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof regarding
public and private sector banks during last
three years, year-wise; and
(c) the corrective measures Government
proposes to take in this regard?
Closure of Keshod Airport in Gujarat
*295. SHRI CHUNIBHAI
KANJIBHAI GOHEL: Will the Minister
of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Keshod
Airport in Gujarat has been closed;
(b) if so, when the airport was
operational and which type of flights used
to operate from there; and
(c) whether Government is
contemplating to restart the commercial
activities from this airport?
Cheating of SBI customers by
unscrupulous elements
*296. SHRI GULAM RASOOL
BALY AWI: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of cases of cheating of
State Bank of India (SBI) customers by
unscrupulous elements impersonating as
SBI officials reported during October and
November this year; and
(b) the details of action taken in each
case?
Criteria for inclusion of drugs in
the National List of Essential
Medicines
†*297. SHRI NARENDRA KUMAR
KASHYAP: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) the criteria for notifying essential or
life saving drugs along with the number of
such scheduled drugs in the country;
(b) whether shortage of Human Serum
Albumin (HSA) and other certain essential
or life saving drugs has been observed in
Delhi and in certain other parts of the
country, if so, the details thereof along with
the reasons therefor;
(c) the details of remedial measures
taken or proposed to be taken by
Government to overcome this problem;
(d) whether Government has received
any representation in this regard, if so, the
details thereof; and
(e) by when some other drugs would
also be notified as essential or life saving
drugs?
Waving off Central Taxes in respect of
Corporate Sector
*298. SHRI ALOK TIW ARI: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Central taxes waived
off in respect of corporate groups and

(b) the names of the top hundred
companies which benefited from tax waiver
during the period;
(c) the reasons and rationale for waiver
of ` 5.32 lakh crore during 2013 to the
richest corporate groups;

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, December 16, 2014/Agrahayana 25, 1936 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Defence; Finance; Health and
Family Welfare; Information and Broadcasting; Minority Affairs)
Total number of questions — 160
Standardization and certification of
Ayurvedic products
2511. SHRI K.N. BALAGOPAL: Will
the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPA THY (AYUSH) be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any facility
for standardization and certification of the
Ayurvedic products and medicines in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, whether Government will look
into the need to start more such certification
centres?
Registered electro-homoeopathy
institutes
2512. SHRIMATI GUNDU
SUDHARANI: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPA THY (AYUSH) be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of the Institutions/
Universities offering the Diploma/Degree
courses for electro-Homoeopathy and the
details thereof; and
(b) whether it is a fact that electro-
homoeopathy institutes such as NEHM
of India, Janakpuri, Electro-Homoeopathy
Medical Council, Hastsal Road, Uttam
Nagar, New Delhi and Board of electro-
Homoeopathy Medicines, Tandon Market,
Lal Bagh, Lucknow (U.P .) are registered
with Government and since when, and if
not, by when Government proposes to take
action against these institutions/
Universities?
Impact of Vacancies on treatment in
AYUSH hospitals
2513. SHRI PRA VEEN RASHTRA-
PAL: Will the Minister of AYURVEDA,
YOGA & NATUROPATHY , UNANI,
SIDDHA AND HOMOEOPATHY
(AYUSH) be pleased to state:
(a) the details of hospitals, health
centres etc. in respect of availability of
Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani,
Siddha and Homoeopathy treatments etc.
in the country; and
(b) whether it is a fact that due to a
number of vacancies in these branches of
hospitals, people do not get required
treatment?

564
De-linking of AYUSH Department
from the Health Ministry
2514. DR. E.M. SUDARSANA
NATCHIAPPAN: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA & NATURO-
PATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA AND
HOMOEOPATHY (AYUSH) be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has formulated
a new policy in changing the Ministry of
Health and Family Welfare into elongated
identification of inner parts of Departments
such as Ayurveda, Yoga, and Naturopathy,
Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH) and de-linking from Ministry of
Health and Family Welfare; and
(b) whether Government has made
allocation to every discipline for multiple
grants from the existing financial support?
Modern Air Navigation System
2515. SHRI ANIL MADHA V DA VE:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Airports Authority of India
(AAI) has developed any modern Air
Navigation System (ANS) for improving
navigation;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
its features and expenditure incurred on its
development;
(c) whether this is being implemented
at various airports in India;
(d) if so, the names of airports with
such facility; and
(e) whether this system can be used for
non-aviation purpose as well and, if so, the
details thereof?
Linking of international flights to
domestic centres
†2516. SHRI RAMDAS ATHAW ALE:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has formulated a plan to link international
flights to domestic centres;
(b) if so, the details of advantages that
Air India and Indian Airlines are likely to
get as a result of this plan; and
(c) by when this plan is likely to be
commenced?
Poor financial conditions of airline
companies in India
2517. DR. PRADEEP KUMAR
BALMUCHU: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the financial
condition of most of the Airline companies
of India is not good and sustainable;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Department of Centre
for Asia-Pacific Aviation reveals the same
thing about Indian airline companies'
financial conditions;
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(e) whether any corrective steps are
being taken by Government to safeguard
airline companies and make them
sustainable?
Lack of basic facilities for helicopter
industry
†2518. SHRI ISHWARLAL
SHANKARLAL JAIN: Will the Minister
of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the helicopter industry is
facing the problem of basic facilities;

the lack of maintenance and monitoring;
(c) whether in majority of cases, the
pilots had no information about the weather
forecast at the time of take off from
helipads;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
